Lands of today's Ukraine on traced source maps

Grey outline = today's Ukraine, used only as a reference; historical borders are not Ukrainian state borders. Crimea, Donetsk and Luhansk: Ukrainian territory unlawfully occupied by Russia today.

Every shape here is a polygon traced from a source map and georeferenced with reference points, not a grid cell. The source maps draw generalised borders, so these are the maps' own borders, to within a few kilometres at best. Solid outline = political territory; dashed outline = archaeological culture, people or hand-drawn zone, which marks distributions, not borders. Shapes are not clipped at today's borders. Hover a shape for its source. Frames without a traced polygon source (862–972, c. 1015, Greek colonies, Goths) are in the grid version.
